messages:
Emily H.: Heads-up: PR #342 (examples/sdk-usage) is ready for review — target merge in the Wed morning docs deploy. Need 2 approvals. Preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.com/pr/342. Main items: new JS SDK snippet + migration note for v0.8->v0.9. Tagging rotation: @Priya R. on docs rotation this week. Can someone pick it up?

Sam K.: I can take first pass on the JS snippets (formatting, fenced blocks). Not sure about the migration note — @Jordan P. did the v0.9 migration doc earlier?

Jordan P.: Yep, I can review the migration note. Quick note: preview shows a link-check failure (relative link to /guides/old-endpoint).

Priya R.: On rotation but heads-down on infra incident til ~15:00 UTC. If the CI fix is mechanical I can do it after. @Emily H. any other blockers for merge besides approvals + link check?

Emily H.: Main blockers: link check + preview rendering of the SDK code block (it’s wrapping oddly and breaking inline types). Also want to ensure the example output matches rendered output (test snapshot). Otherwise roll out window Wed 09:00 UTC.

Sam K.: Ran the preview locally, here's what failed: 
```
ERROR: link-check failed: /guides/old-endpoint -> 404
WARN: long code line: src/examples/js/usage.md line 42
```
I can fix code wrapping in a follow-up but link needs author attention. Author is @Lucas (not in this thread) — @Oliver M. can you update the link target to the new guide slug?

Oliver M.: I can push a quick commit to redirect that link to /guides/migration-endpoints and add an HTML redirect snippet so existing anchors keep working. Will coordinate with CI.

Priya R.: If Oliver fixes the link, I can review and merge once we have two approvals. @Jordan P. will you +1 the migration text after your pass?

Jordan P.: I will +1 pending a tiny wording nit: prefer '0.9' (no leading v) in the migration headings for consistency. I'll add an inline comment on the PR.

docs-bot: CI: Build started for PR #342. Preview URL: https://docs-preview.redwood.com/pr/342/build/7

Sam K.: Also, if we need a second reviewer on SDK style/JS ergonomics, I nominate @Oliver M. since he owns the JS SDK snippets.

Oliver M.: Happy to review snippets after I open the commit for the link fix. Quick question: does this new example need to show streaming vs non-streaming? The current PR only covers non-streaming — should we call that out?

Emily H.: Good call. Please add one sentence: "This example demonstrates non-streaming usage; streaming examples are in the following section." Keep the PR focused.

Priya R.: OK marking assigned reviewers: Sam K., Jordan P., Oliver M. Emily to merge after approvals + green CI. I’ll plan the merge at Wed 09:05 UTC unless any blockers surface.

Emily H.: Thanks all — adding labels: docs/needs-2-approvals, docs/merge-window:2026-03-25-09:00. If anyone hits CI flakiness ping me directly.

Oliver M.: Pushed link-fix commit (force-pushed small redirect). CI build re-triggered.

docs-bot: CI: Build passed for PR #342. Preview URL: https://docs-preview.redwood.com/pr/342/build/8

Priya R.: All green and two approvals present. Merging in a few minutes. /done :shipit:
